content:
jess_support: @sarah_medico thanks — opening an escalation for Medico Health BAA/HIPAA addendum. You said audit export for 2026-03-12 02:00–05:00 returned 0 entries and you rotated the KMS key on 2026-03-11 23:30 UTC. Can you confirm customer environment (Dedicated vs Private) and the exact KMS key id?

sarah_medico: We're on Private (VPC) with HSM-backed key `medico-primary`. Export job for that window returned no records. We rotated the key at 2026-03-11T23:31 UTC (internal id req-5599). Medico legal needs evidence for the audit and an HSM attestation.

matt_security: :eyes: Pinging infra. Do rotation events show up in our KMS audit index? Quick query we can run: 
```
SELECT * FROM audit.events
WHERE resource='kms/key/medico-primary'
AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-11T23:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T06:00:00Z';
```

anya_infra: Ran that. We see a rotation event at `2026-03-11T23:31:12Z`. The export job for 2026-03-12 02:00 failed with an auth error referencing HSM. Job log excerpt: 
```
job_id=exp-84721
status=FAILED
error="auth: signing failed: hsm-unavailable"
```

oncall_bot: deploy-bot: rolling restart completed 2026-03-11T22:45 UTC; noticed `node-12` hsm-proxy crash at 2026-03-11T22:58 UTC during cert rotation.

jess_support: Looks like the export failed due to a transient HSM outage. Two tracks: (A) re-run export against archived local logs, (B) get HSM vendor attestation showing outage window. Sarah — can you confirm Medico is OK with a one-time non-HSM fallback if we cannot get HSM signing for the export? Legal needs explicit approval.

sarah_medico: Medico legal copied here — they prefer HSM-signed logs but will accept a documented fallback if we disclose it. I can confirm verbally here (req-5599) and will formalize in email.

kevin_legal: For BAA compliance we need: chain-of-custody, a remediation timeline, the raw exported logs (unchanged timestamps), and vendor attestation of the HSM outage. If fallback signing is used, the export manifest must note that and include checksums. We need this within 48h for the audit.

anya_infra: Proposed repro/remediation steps: 
1) Re-run export tool with `--force-rerun --from 2026-03-12T02:00Z --to 2026-03-12T05:00Z --kms-key medico-primary`
2) If HSM still unresponsive, switch to software-signing fallback (requires security/legal approval) using `--fallback-software-sign` flag 
3) Compute checksums: `sha256sum export-*.tar.gz > export.sha256` and include manifest with original entry timestamps.

matt_security: Security will only approve the non-HSM fallback with explicit Medico legal sign-off. We also need to record the decision in the incident ticket and include a follow-up plan to remediate the HSM cluster.

sarah_medico: Medico legal (cc Kevin) approves a one-time fallback for re-export as long as the export manifest clearly states the fallback and vendor attestation is provided.

jess_support: Action items: 
- Anya: re-run export and provide checksum + location (ETA 1h)
- Matt: draft one-time fallback attestation template for non-HSM signing (ETA 2h)
- Sarah/Medico: formal sign-off (we have verbal)
- Kevin: collate legal docs to include in BAA addendum packet

anya_infra: Starting re-run now (job_id=exp-84721-rerun). Will post status.

anya_infra: job completed at 2026-03-12T03:20:10Z. export stored at s3://redwood-exports/medico/2026-03-12/export-20260312.tar.gz
md5=9b1c4f5d7e8a6b3c, sha256=abc123def4567890...
Manifest includes original record timestamps and a note: "exported after HSM outage; records preserved; signing uses software fallback per customer approval"

matt_security: Preparing the fallback attestation template now. Will include: incident summary, justification (customer approval), list of exported files + checksums, and steps taken to validate integrity.

oncall_bot: Created vendor ticket VT-9921 and alerted vendor on-call.

vendor_oncall: Vendor update: transient HA failover during cert rotation impacted hsm-proxy cluster. Root cause: cert misplacement during automated rotation. Resolution applied 2026-03-12T01:45Z. Attestation PDF: https://vendor.example/attestations/VT-9921.pdf

kevin_legal: Received vendor attestation and export checksums. I confirm the manifest shows original timestamps unchanged. Preparing final BAA addendum note and sign-off.

jess_support: Closing loop — created support ticket SUP-2026-331, attached export and vendor attestation. Medico legal to confirm receipt and we'll follow up for formal BAA amendment. :white_check_mark:

sarah_medico: Received everything. Thanks team. :pray:
